notes: Fixes four leftovers from the dice-to-chart rename, found from your screenshots. Two banners and a popup title still told you to run the old 🎲 button; they now point at 📊. More importantly, the check that stops the days-like-today chip appearing twice on watchlist rows was still looking for the old dice symbol, so watchlist rows could show the chip doubled — the check now looks for the chip itself rather than its symbol, so a future rename can never break it again.
